about.description: The story behind Puzzle Zimablue, a daily game made by a French developer around Zimablue illustrations.
about.title: First a gift. Then a game.
about.intro: I’m a French developer who loves making things.
about.origin: Puzzle Zimablue started as a birthday present for a close friend. She didn’t really take to it, so I recycled the idea into this little daily game featuring illustrations published on zimablue.cc.
about.thanks: Thanks for playing! I hope you’ll enjoy coming back for the daily puzzle.
about.feedback: Open a GitHub issue or send me an email.
about.codeLicense: The source code is released under the MIT License.
about.artRights: The Zimablue illustrations and logo are all rights reserved and are not covered by the code license.
